function: OTFS channel estimation: LS-driven CENet (parallel per-delay CNN sub-networks) refines LS estimates of the delay-time domain channel matrix to handle fractional Doppler shifts (p. 1, 3).
system: OTFS link, no RIS, antenna array not stated (single-link model); 5 GHz, 15 kHz spacing, M=32, N=8, 4-QAM, embedded pilot, speeds 500 to 1000 km/h (p. 2, 4).
method: CENet: model-driven CNN, lmax+1 parallel sub-networks (three conv layers of 16 filters, dense 512) fed with LS estimates; supervised MSE regression with Adam, batch 64 (p. 3-4).
data_channel: Simulated OTFS over the 3GPP Extended Vehicular A (EVA) model [16], 9 paths, Rayleigh gains, Jakes Doppler; training set 2000 symbols per SNR, 0 to 30 dB (p. 4-5).
test_conditions: Trained on data SNR 0 to 30 dB; tested over pilot SNR, data SNR and speeds of 500, 700, 1000 km/h (Fig. 5); training speed not stated (p. 4).
baselines: Non-learned: LS estimator in DT domain [14], threshold-based embedded-pilot estimator [7]. Learned: earlier DNN-based fractional-Doppler estimator in DD domain [17]; BER compared with LS and perfect CSI (p. 4).
metrics: Channel estimation MSE versus pilot SNR and speed; BER versus data SNR against LS and perfect CSI; FLOPs, parameters and per-sample prediction time (p. 4).
complexity: CENet: 0.76M FLOPs, 0.26M parameters, 0.26 us to predict each sample; DNN baseline of [17] has 0.11M FLOPs (p. 4).
q1_support: p. 4: "The wireless channel follows the Extended Vehicular A (EVA) model from [16]", a 3GPP document (p. 5); a standardized model other than TR 38.901, flagged in notes.
q2_support: p. 4: "demonstrating the robustness of the CENet approach under varying Doppler conditions", but the training speed is not stated, so no test in conditions unseen in training is shown; SNR sweeps do not count.
q3_support: p. 4: "the threshold-based [7] and DNN-based [17] estimators in DD domain are considered for comparison" besides LS; "the MSE of our proposed CENet remains the smallest".
q4_support: p. 4: "its number of floating point operations (FLOPs) is 0.76M", with 0.26M parameters and 0.26 us per sample.
q5_support: p. 4: "In the training set, we generate 2000 symbols" from its own simulation; no link, DOI, public dataset or measured data.
notes: Area 4: OTFS channel estimation, done in the delay-time domain, which is equivalent to the DD channel, so 4 by the order rule over 2. ris=0. q1=1 rests on EVA, a 3GPP standardized model other than TR 38.901 (ref. [16] is 3GPP Tech. Rep. 36.104 as cited); reviewer to confirm. Borderline q2: Fig. 5 (p. 4) shows 500, 700 and 1000 km/h but the training speed is never stated, so q2=0 under the explicit-statement rule; the antenna configuration is also not stated.
